context: Tests whether swift-concurrency handles a measured synchronous parallel-for without an invalid async substitution or an overly broad unsafe opt-out.

checklist.name: Boundary Choice
checklist.description: Keeps DispatchQueue.concurrentPerform for the measured synchronous entry point and explains that a task group is an async redesign rather than a drop-in replacement; it does not claim finite CPU work inherently violates cooperative-executor forward progress.

checklist.name: Capture Diagnosis
checklist.description: Identifies both UnsafeBufferPointer and UnsafeMutableBufferPointer views as non-Sendable captures under Swift 6 complete concurrency checking and notes that concurrentPerform's closure is @Sendable.

checklist.name: Narrow Unsafe Boundary
checklist.description: Confines nonisolated(unsafe) to local input and output base-pointer bindings captured by the closure, rather than applying it to either buffer view, the function, or the enclosing utility.

checklist.name: Access Proof
checklist.description: Provides an adjacent safety argument covering the actual index or range arithmetic, bounds, aliases and absence of conflicting concurrent access, initialization versus mutation, and pointer lifetime through the synchronous join.

checklist.name: Disjointness Accuracy
checklist.description: Treats disjoint per-iteration access as a reason synchronization may be unnecessary without calling disjointness itself synchronization, and does not impose blanket input/output non-aliasing when a proven nonconflicting in-place transform could be valid.

checklist.name: Correct Initialization
checklist.description: The fresh-array example initializes previously uninitialized output elements rather than assigning through an initialized-memory subscript, and sets the initialized element count only after the joined loop completes.

checklist.name: Cancellation Contract
checklist.description: Explains that concurrentPerform does not automatically inherit Swift task cancellation and either defines an explicit thread-safe signal with partial-output semantics or states that this synchronous implementation completes the whole output before returning.

checklist.name: Tiled Reaudit
checklist.description: Requires a fresh range, bounds, alias, and cross-iteration access proof when element-wise indexing changes to multi-element tiles.

checklist.name: Performance Evidence
checklist.description: Requires representative benchmark-versus-serial measurement and serial-result equivalence checks before retaining the parallel path, and treats them as engineering evidence rather than Apple guarantees.

checklist.name: Nested Parallelism
checklist.description: Cautions against nested parallel loops unless separate measurement shows that the resulting oversubscription is beneficial.
